Halifax Regional Municipality
Regional Centre Land Use By-Law
Part I Administration
1 This By-law enables:
(a) as-of-right development;
(b) the regulation of land use and development within the Regional Centre Plan Area.
2 The Regional Centre Plan Area includes the Halifax Peninsula and Dartmouth inside the Circumferential Highway.
3 In this By-law:
(a) "dwelling unit" means a self-contained living quarters with a private entrance;
(b) "secondary suite" means a dwelling unit accessory to a single-unit dwelling on the same lot;
(c) "home occupation" means an occupation carried on within a dwelling unit by a resident;
(d) "lot coverage" means the percentage of lot area covered by buildings.
9 Development Permit Exemptions
The following do not require a development permit:
(a) interior renovations that do not change the use;
(b) exterior maintenance using the same materials;
(c) fences under 2 metres in a rear or side yard;
(d) accessory buildings under 20 square metres in a rear yard;
(r) an internal conversion of a building with a commercial use in a DD or DH zone.
15 Matters Subject to Site Plan Approval
(a) parking layout and access;
(b) landscaping and screening;
(c) building design in heritage conservation districts;
(h) applicability of general design requirements for a new construction on a registered heritage property.
26 Diagrams
(a) The diagrams in this By-law are for illustration only;
(b) do not form a part of this By-law; and
(c) shall not be used in the interpretation of this By-law.
Part II Zones and Use Permissions
30 The following zones are established for the Regional Centre Plan Area:
(a) CEN-1 Centre 1 Zone;
(b) CEN-2 Centre 2 Zone;
(c) COR Corridor Zone;
(d) DD Downtown Dartmouth Zone;
(e) DH Downtown Halifax Zone;
(f) ER-1 Established Residential 1 Zone;
(g) ER-2 Established Residential 2 Zone;
(h) ER-3 Established Residential 3 Zone;
(i) HR-1 Higher Order Residential 1 Zone;
(j) HR-2 Higher Order Residential 2 Zone;
(k) INS Institutional Zone;
(l) RPK Regional Park Zone.

49 Combination of Uses in Established Residential Zones
In the ER-1, ER-2, and ER-3 zones the following uses may be combined on a single lot:
(a) home occupation use;
(b) secondary suite use.

Part IV Overlays
110 Heritage Conservation District Overlay
(a) Heritage conservation districts are identified on Schedule 22.
(b) Within a heritage conservation district, no development permit shall be issued for the demolition of a registered heritage property without the approval of the Heritage Advisory Committee.
(c) New construction within a heritage conservation district shall be sympathetic to the character of the district.
111 Height Precinct Overlay
(a) Maximum building heights in the CEN-1, CEN-2, COR, DD, and DH zones are governed by the height precinct identified on Schedule 15.
(b) Where Schedule 15 specifies a maximum height, that height prevails over Table 5.
112 Floor Area Ratio Overlay
(a) Maximum floor area ratios in the CEN-1, CEN-2, COR, DD, and DH zones are governed by Schedule 17.
(b) Bonus zoning incentives for affordable housing are shown on Schedule 50.
Part V Parking
120 Off-Street Parking Requirements
(a) A residential development shall provide a minimum of 1 parking space per dwelling unit.
(b) Despite clause (a), no off-street parking is required for a development in the CEN-1, CEN-2, DH, or DD zone.
(c) A non-residential development shall provide parking at the ratios in Table 8.
(d) Bicycle parking shall be provided at a minimum of 1 space per 4 dwelling units.
Schedule 15
Height Precinct Map: maximum building heights for each precinct area.
Schedule 17
Floor Area Ratio Precinct Map: maximum floor area ratios for each precinct area.
Schedule 22
Heritage Conservation District Map: boundaries of heritage conservation districts.
Schedule 50
Bonus Zoning District Map: areas eligible for bonus zoning incentives.
